_comment: Canonical BNB Smart Chain testnet (chainId 97) per-asset risk params. JSON is the single source of truth for deploy + front + sim + docs.

_network.name: BNB Smart Chain Testnet
_network.note: Chapel is Binance's internal codename for BSC testnet — same chain as chainId 97.

_units.minFeeBps: PBPS on-chain (Asset.minFeeBps). 100 PBPS = 1 bp = 0.01%. 1 PBPS = 0.0001% = 0.01 bp. Protocol floor: MIN_FEE_PBPS = 1.

stable-core._paramNote: Competitiveness: minFee 0.1bp + θ 0.1bp + tight per-asset dispersion (1–6bp bands from observed peg ranges) + 4-knot center-bump profile. Absolute peg discounts (e.g. FDUSD ~0.997) live in the NXR mark; dispersion is WIDTH around mark only.
stable-core._perAssetNote: minDispersion = observed tight trading-band WIDTH in PBPS (100 PBPS=1bp), mark-relative — absolute discount vs $1 is carried by the NXR mark, not the spline. USDC 1bp (0.9997–0.9998), USDG 2bp (0.9999–1.0001), USDT 6bp (0.9993–0.9999), USD1/USDe/FDUSD 5bp. Shape: 4-knot center bump (min for a peak) sharedLiquidityProfile — 75% depth in center 24% of band (~3.1× vs flat). USDG listed for add when feed+token live.

depositCapScheduleUsd._comment: Testnet growth schedule $50K->$1M. Per-asset split = observed 3mo stable-stable volume weights (base USDC 35%, USDT 26%, USD1 27%, FDUSD 8.5%, USDe 3.5%). USDe kept tiny (near-0 BSC flow + depeg risk). Raise the active tier via setAssetParams as TVL fills; win-share by count (~23%) is TVL-invariant, volume-share and abs fees scale up ($8k/yr@50K -> $111k/yr@1M).

markSource._comment: The keeper reads NXR REST marks and pushes them to ExternalOracle under the deviation-θ, confidence-spike and heartbeat policy. NXR is the sole BTR-facing market-data boundary.

volatile-core._paramNote: Fee charged = pathSpread/2 (Pricing.sol). Mean arb gate (not worst-case 2θ): center_error_mean ≤ minFee/2. Replay BTC/ETH/BNB: θ=10+fee=10 PASS (edge −0.6bp); θ=10+fee=5 FAIL; θ=5+fee=10 PASS but ~70% more pushes. Launch: minFee=10bp (1000 PBPS), θ=10. Dispersion 2026-07-11: minDisp 50_000 PBPS (5%) × knots ±50 → ±2.5% half-band (was 1000/±5bp — too tight for BTC depth viz). fee=5 only if θ≲5 and you accept higher keeper gas — still FAIL at θ=5/fee=5 on mean edge.

sharedLiquidityProfile._comment: Min knots for a center bump: 4 knots / 3 segments. Outer ±50% of dispersion (= full band width). Center segment ±12% of band gets 75% of depth (~3.1× denser than flat).

feeFloorsHuman.note: Launch: stable ~0.1bp (10 PBPS) with θ=0.1; volatile 10bp (1000 PBPS) with θ=10. Fee charged is half path spread, so mean arb gate is center_error ≤ minFee/2. Volatile fee=5 fails that gate at θ=10.
